signature: SUBROUTINE ZGBSV( N, KL, KU, NRHS, AB, LDAB, IPIV, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: On entry, the matrix A in band storage, in rows `KL`+1 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$; rows 1 to `KL` of the array need not be set. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(KL+KU+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{KU}) \le i \le \min (N,j+\mathrm{KL})$ On exit, details of the factorization: U is stored as an upper triangular band matrix with `KL`+`KU` superdiagonals in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1, and the multipliers used during the factorization are stored in rows `KL`+`KU`+2 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$. See below for further details.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices that define the permutation matrix P; row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-`NRHS` right hand side matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the N-by-`NRHS` solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, U(i,i) is exactly zero.  The factorization has been completed, but the factor U is exactly singular, and the solution has not been computed.
